No local rasterizer, so I'll render the exact `DriftSky` field on a canvas in Chrome and export a real PNG. Writing the generator now - it reuses your exact star params (count formula, sizes, the 4% blue "hot" stars with glow) and brand type tokens.

input.content:
<!doctype html>
<html>
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>html,body{margin:0;background:#111}</style></head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="1200" height="630" style="width:600px;height:315px"></canvas>
<script>
// Recreate the shipped DriftSky field (src/DriftSky.tsx) as one still frame,
// sized for a 1200x630 social card. Same star params so the card matches
// the real black waitlist sky exactly.
const W = 1200, H = 630;
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// Seeded RNG so the card is reproducible run-to-run.
function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=(a+0x6D2B79F5)|0;let t=Math.imul(a^(a>>>15),1|a);t=(t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),61|t))^t;return ((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};}
const rand = mulberry32(0x5EED11);

function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // DriftSky density formula, same as the app.
  const count = Math.min(300, Math.floor((W*H)/3600));
  for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const depth = rand();
    const x = rand()*W;
    const y = rand()*H;
    const size = 0.5 + depth*1.6;
    const base = 0.1 + depth*0.45;
    const hot = rand() < 0.04;
    const tw = 0.7 + 0.3*Math.sin(rand()*6.28); // frozen twinkle phase
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x,y,size,0,6.2832);
    if (hot){
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(10,132,255,${base+0.2})`;
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(10,132,255,.8)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${base*tw})`;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    }
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Brand type. Tokens pulled from index.css: headline #f5f5f7 weight 600
  // letter-spacing -0.03em; sub #b8b8bd; eyebrow #98989d 0.16em uppercase.
  const cx = W/2;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5f5f7';
  ctx.font = '600 104px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif';
  ctx.letterSpacing = '-3px';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  ctx.fillText('Haven', cx, 320);

  ctx.letterSpacing = '0px';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#b8b8bd';
  ctx.font = '400 34px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('A personal memory layer over the people of your life.', cx, 380);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#98989d';
  ctx.font = '500 20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif';
  ctx.letterSpacing = '3px';
  ctx.fillText('INHAVENS.COM', cx, 470);
  ctx.letterSpacing = '0px';
}

// Wait for the system font to be ready so metrics are right, then draw.
document.fonts.ready.then(()=>{ draw(); window.__b64 = canvas.toDataURL('image/png').split(',')[1]; window.__ready = true; });
</script>
</body>
</html>

import base64, os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _cors(self):
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '*')

    def do_GET(self):
        path = self.path.split('?')[0]
        fp = os.path.join(ROOT, path.lstrip('/') or 'og-gen.html')
        if not os.path.isfile(fp):
            self.send_response(404); self._cors(); self.end_headers(); return
        self.send_response(200); self._cors()
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/html'); self.end_headers()
        with open(fp, 'rb') as f:
            self.wfile.write(f.read())

    def do_POST(self):
        n = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        data = self.rfile.read(n)
        with open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'og.png'), 'wb') as f:
            f.write(base64.b64decode(data))
        self.send_response(200); self._cors(); self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'ok')

    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 8799), H).serve_forever()
